name: Currency Converter
author: Hermes
description: Converts currencies using live ECB exchange rates via Frankfurter.

tools.name: convert_currency
tools.description: Convert an amount from one currency to another using live exchange rates. Supported: 3-letter currency codes like USD, EUR, GBP, INR, JPY.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Source currency code, e.g. USD, EUR

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Target currency code, e.g. INR, GBP
